decisions.reason: The corridor effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY specifying the 28 cm wall move and intended corridor narrowing.
Moving one room wall to narrow the corridor does not change the dwelling count or Unit 1 configuration.
The source does not change the allocation of the former WC area to Unit 1.
The referenced adjacent room wall is unrelated to balcony enclosure or retention; the lexical overlap is incidental.
The corridor wall relocation does not entail any change to Unit 1 kitchen configuration, cabinetry, or dimensions.
The source does not change Unit 3 kitchen placement, cabinet dimensions, or bathroom-door clearance requirements.
Narrowing the corridor by relocating an adjacent room wall does not alter the common or independent entrance-door requirements.
The source's bathroom clause concerns Unit 3, while the partition-wall change does not alter Unit 1 bathroom assignment or toilet positioning.
The partition-wall relocation does not itself change drainage alignment; the independent Unit 3 drain-location clause from the same message is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The wall relocation does not change which furnishings or refrigerators must appear in the separate furnished drawing.
The source does not entail any change to Unit 2 kitchen configuration or cabinetry.
The partition-wall relocation does not change Unit 3 bathroom fixture layout; the independent shower-location clause from the same message is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
